text:
Predicates:
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
FootballClub(y) ::: y is a football club.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.

Premises:
Ailton(Silva) ∧ BornIn(Ailton, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(Ailton, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is known as Ailton.
Footballer(Ailton) ∧ LoanedOut(Ailton, Braga) ::: Ailton is a footballer who was loaned out to Braga.
Brazilian(Ailton) ∧ PlaysFor(Ailton, Nautico) ::: Ailton is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(Nautico) ∧ FootballClub(Braga) ::: Nautico and Braga are football clubs.
FootballClub(Fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.

Conclusion:
¬LoanedOut(Ailton, y) ::: Ailton was not loaned out to a football club.
